representativeness.notes: All gap statements are relative to the exposed Gold benchmark reference profile (a manually curated, intentionally balanced benchmark), not to empirical user-query frequency. Representativeness classification uses benchmark reference fit plus independent domain-relevance judgment. Counts cover all 28 loaded records: the 16 frozen N1 questions, the 6 human-approved N2-A Batch 1 records (approved, not split_frozen), and 6 unreviewed N2-B Batch 2 drafts (n026-n031, lifecycle draft, of which 3 are exploratory-class). Only the original 16 are split_frozen. The N1 pilot remains frozen (Git-preserved 0.2.0 baseline); the 0.3.0 expansion dataset remains incomplete and not frozen, and no representative/exploratory quota is active.
